vt1025015.title: Nikon Z50 20.9MP Mirrorless Camera with NIKKOR Z DX 16-50mm VR Lens Kit
vt1025015.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1025015.details: Nikon Z50 APS-C mirrorless camera in black (Nikon Z mount, 20.9 megapixels) with the NIKKOR Z DX 16-50mm f/3.5-6.3 VR kit lens. Condition: good, with slight signs of use; the shutter count is about 22,834. The body has slight scuffs and the metal part of the bottom has slight wear and scratches. The tilting touch LCD is in good condition with no yellowing or deterioration, and the sensor and the viewfinder are clean. The kit lens has slight signs of use and a small amount of dust inside. Operation was checked: the shutter, autofocus, buttons, dials, viewfinder and LCD display work normally, and the lens autofocus, zoom, aperture and image stabilization work normally. Included, as listed: the Z50 body, the NIKKOR Z DX 16-50mm f/3.5-6.3 VR lens, the lens front cap, a battery, a battery charger with its power cable, a USB cable and a Nikon strap. No SD card is included. The battery is a consumable part and is not covered.
vt1025015.why: A used Nikon Z50 mirrorless camera with 16-50mm kit lens.
vt1025015.perfect: Travelers, vloggers and hobbyists who want a compact APS-C mirrorless camera with a versatile kit lens.
vt1025015.exp: A pre-owned Nikon Z50 mirrorless camera with 16-50mm kit lens in the condition described above.
vt1025015.cd: Pre-owned, in good condition with slight signs of use; shutter count about 22,834. Slight scuffs on the body, and slight wear and scratches on the metal part of the bottom. The LCD, sensor and viewfinder are clean. The kit lens has slight signs of use and a small amount of dust inside. Operation (shutter, autofocus, buttons, dials, viewfinder and LCD) was checked and works. Battery and other consumable parts are not covered. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
